speakerA.en: What are you going to do tomorrow?
Do you want to have dinner together?

speakerB.en: I'm going to visit the dentist in the morning.
I'll probably stay home and rest.
Yes, that sounds good. I'll call you at six.

speakerA.en: Do you have any plans for next weekend?

speakerB.en: We're going to visit my aunt in another city.
We'll take the train. It's cheaper than driving.

speakerA.en: I'm going to start a new job next month.
I'll work in a bank, in the customer service team.
Maybe. The new office is far from my home.

speakerB.en: Congratulations! What will you do there?
Are you going to move to a new house?
Well, I'm sure everything will be fine.

speakerA.en: I'm going to have a party on Saturday.
About ten friends. Can you help me cook?
I'll make rice and chicken. Can you bring a cake?

speakerB.en: Of course. What are we going to make?
Sure, I'll buy one from the bakery.

scenarios.context: Two classmates talk about the future.

speakerA.en: What are you going to do after the English course?
Will you study in another country?
I think you'll do very well.

speakerB.en: I'm going to take a test next year.
Maybe. I'll decide after the test.
Thank you. I hope you're right.
